name: Claude Damn
description:
A SME of SWE: a plugin giving Claude Code the expertise of an Expert Software Engineer across every SWE area, while still inviting novice programmers to make gains on best-practice rails. Layers on top of `obra/superpowers`.

Ships:
- 38+ skills in super/duper/cat/tdd modifier families (20+ combinatoric variants)
- Multi-phase `/expert-review` with language-specific + cloud + security  lenses
- `/sme-test` coaching-driven test authoring
- `/tesseract` cross-session memory via file I/O (anchor + shelf + bulk-beings)
- `/checkpoint-save` + `/checkpoint-resume` for work-state across sessions
- Pre-tool `block-inline-scripts` hook (blocks multiline non-Bash scripts + enforces command length / separator limits)
- Per-session cost tracking (`/cost_`, `/cost-opt`) via JSONL logs
- Opinionated `CLAUDE.md` with model routing, Python/FastAPI style, pytest/behave standards

Post-install, skills are invoked via slash commands: `/tdd`, `/super-duper-cat`, `/expert-review`, `/checkpoint-save`, `/tesseract`, etc. Full combinatoric table in `skills/README.md`.
longDescription:
Ships **61 skills** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (61): `add-to-roadmap` (Use when you want to append a new task to a specific phase or section of the project…), `address-pr-feedback` (Address PR Feedback command), `atlas` (Render a single "where am I, what have I done, what's next" survey HTML page composing anchor cascade…), `cat` (Subagent-driven development as the explicit combination of /subagent-driven-development (sequential, review-gated execution) and /dispatching-parallel-agents (independent fan-out)), `check-yourself` (Use when a discrete task boundary is crossed in multi-step work — step completion, subagent dispatch return, Skill-tool…), `checkpoint-resume` (Use when resuming paused work, starting a session where a CHECKPOINT.md exists, or when the user says "continue…), `checkpoint-save` (Use when pausing work that will be resumed later, when switching contexts, or when the user asks to…), `continue` (retry last operation attempted before the user interrupted the process, or otherwise continue last attempted tool use), and 53 more
- **Hooks** (1): `PreToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-damn@claude-community` from `laurac8r/claude-damn`.
